_comment: Manual triage of every finding the corpus run reported. Each was checked against that project's own git history and source tree by hand; the corpus harness does not produce these labels. Keyed by repo and target.

arrow:arrow.locale.note: the module is arrow/locales.py (plural); no arrow/locale.py has ever existed

griffe:devdeps.txt.note: existed at a5ef8eb (2024-07-10), removed in 48ad843 (2024-10-11); the guide still points at it

httpx:httpx.Mounts.note: documented with a full usage example since 3faa4a8 (2024-02-14); no such class in any commit

jinja:Environment.call.note: explicit cross-reference target; Environment defines call_filter and call_test but no call

rich:rich.ScreenContext.update.note: ScreenContext is never exported from the rich package root; it lives at rich.console.ScreenContext

rich:rich.console.Print.print.note: no Print class exists in rich.console; Console.print was meant. Two occurrences

structlog:structlog.stdlib._NAME_TO_LEVE.note: the mapping moved to structlog._log_levels; structlog's own docstring says so

werkzeug:Request.make_conditional.note: make_conditional is defined on Response, not Request

werkzeug:werkzeug.exceptions.RequestRedi.note: RequestRedirect lives in werkzeug.routing.exceptions and is not re-exported into werkzeug.exceptions
